0022600106.text: The Bucks (0-2, fifth in the Central and 13th in the East) make their third trip of the season to Philadelphia (2-0, first in the Atlantic and third in the East), with Milwaukee 0-1 on the road and on a two-game losing streak. The 76ers are missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), LeBron James (back), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and Dean Wade is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 126-106 in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026.
